what: Remeasurement of the shipped grc-joint-v3 checkpoint on the pinned PapyGreek folds after two inference corrections: the Leiden editorial apparatus mark (combining dot below, U+0323) is removed before the lemma lookup tables and the edit script are consulted, and the dependency relation of a token whose head is not the artificial ROOT is selected from the non-root labels.
protocol: greek.use_neural_pipeline(); greek.evaluate_on_papygreek(); CPU sequential; batch_size=None; long_input=windowed; complete coverage; gold tokenization; official CoNLL-2018 evaluator. layer='orig' gives the diplomatic row; the two documentary rows add use_documentary_reconciliation() and then use_documentary_lemma_rescue(). DBBE uses greek.evaluate_on_dbbe() (tagging only, parse=False).
folds_unchanged: Every fold identity and sha256 is the same as in the evidence being superseded, and both materialized CoNLL-U digests were recomputed from the cached files for this record. Only the inference path changed.

diff_scope.predicted: The apparatus correction affects lemma composition only; the relation correction affects the dependency label only. UPOS, XPOS, UFeats and UAS must therefore return byte-identical values, and LAS/CLAS may move only by the tokens whose label changed.
diff_scope.observed: Confirmed on every PapyGreek row: upos, xpos, ufeats and uas are byte-identical to training/results/decoder-v2-papygreek-remeasure-2026-07-18.json. Lemma gains 783 tokens on the regularized layer (+3.5227 points) and 793 on the diplomatic layer (+3.5677). LAS gains 2 tokens (regularized) and 4 (diplomatic); CLAS gains 3.1 and 6.3 content-word tokens respectively. UAS unchanged while LAS moved is the expected signature of a label-only correction.
diff_scope.relation_invariant: Scored over the whole regularized fold before evaluation: 1,551 sentences / 22,227 tokens, 0 tokens carrying the relation 'root' with a head other than 0.
